author: claude
text:
docs: revise branch topology — dispatches branch, steps commit

Simplify: branches only at dispatch boundaries (user message or
subagent tool call); steps are linear commits within a branch.
Two branch classes (exchange, invocation). Broaden Dispatch to cover
both forms. Add intermediate compaction with workflow-configurable
triggers (every_n_commits, every_t_seconds, flush). Status v0.3.
